website_summary.name: Infinite Tile Canvas Editor
website_summary.description: The website features a sleek, customizable grid-based canvas designed for interactive tile manipulation with a responsive control panel.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a clean and modern design with a dark background and a prominent grid overlay that represents the tiles. It consists of a large canvas area on the left side for user interaction where tiles can be highlighted. On the right side, there is a detailed control panel with sections for grid settings, color customization, tile click functionality, and action buttons. The controls allow for adjusting the size of the grid and tiles, selecting colors for the grid lines and highlight, and toggling tile click selection. There are two buttons labeled 'Clear All Highlights' and 'Reset View', both clearly visible and easily accessible. Additionally, there's a view information display at the bottom left that provides real-time data on canvas pan, zoom, mouse position, and highlighted tiles.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers several interactive functions including the ability to pan the canvas, zoom in and out from the mouse position, and select tiles to highlight them. Grid settings allow the custom sizing of tiles and the grid itself, while color settings enable users to choose both the grid lines and highlight colors through input fields. The checkbox for tile click functionality can be toggled to enable or disable tile selection on click. Action buttons provide the ability to remove all highlighting from the tiles and reset the view to its default state. The canvas is designed to support infinite tiles in all directions.
